r1.name: Harees with Chicken
r1.summary: Whole wheat cooked with chicken until smooth, the first dish of Ramadan.
steps: Wash the harees and soak it in water for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Boil the chicken with the onion, cardamom, cinnamon and salt in 8 cups of water for 30 minutes, then lift it out and take the meat off the bone.
Drain the harees, add it to the stock and leave it on low heat for an hour and a half, stirring every quarter of an hour, until it is cooked and falls apart.
Return the chicken and beat the mixture with a wooden masher or a hand blender until smooth and thick.
Serve hot with the melted butter on top and a pinch of cinnamon.
r1.tip: Soak the harees overnight and it cooks an hour faster.

r2.name: Jareesh with Chicken
r2.summary: Crushed wheat cooked in chicken stock and stirred with laban, topped with fried onion.
steps: Wash the jareesh and soak it for an hour.
Boil the chicken with half the onion, the salt and black pepper in 7 cups of water for 30 minutes, then lift it out, take the meat off the bone and cut it up.
Add the drained jareesh to the stock and cook on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring, until it has soaked up the stock.
Return the chicken with the laban, cumin and butter and stir for 5 minutes on low heat without letting the laban boil.
Fry the rest of the onion in slices in the oil until golden and spread it over the jareesh.
r2.tip: Add the laban last, on low heat, so it does not curdle.

k1.name: Chicken Kabsa
k1.summary: A whole chicken with spiced basmati rice, the home favourite.
steps: Cut the chicken into four pieces. Wash the rice and soak it for 20 minutes.
Soften the chopped onion in the oil, then add the garlic, tomato paste and kabsa spices and stir for a minute.
Add the chicken and stir, then cover with five cups of hot water and the salt and cook on medium heat for 35 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and brown it in the oven for 10 minutes. Make the stock up to four and a half cups and add the drained rice.
Cook the rice covered on low heat for 20 minutes, then serve with the chicken on top.

k2.name: Okra Stew with Chicken
k2.summary: Chicken pieces with okra in tomato sauce, served with white rice.
steps: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil on both sides, then set aside.
In the same pot, soften the onion and garlic, then add the tomato paste and coriander and stir.
Return the chicken with 3 cups of hot water and salt, and cook on medium heat for 25 minutes.
Add the okra while still frozen, with the lemon juice, and cook for 12 minutes without stirring much.
Boil the rice separately and serve it with the stew.

k3.name: Pasta with Minced Meat
k3.summary: Pasta in a red sauce of minced meat and peppers, a favourite with children.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water for the time on the pack and drain it, keeping a cup of the cooking water.
Brown the minced meat in the oil until its liquid has gone, then add the onion, garlic and chopped pepper.
Add the tomato paste, spices and the cup of cooking water, and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce over the heat for two minutes and serve.

k4.name: Chicken Thigh and Potato Tray
k4.summary: Chicken thighs with potatoes, lemon and garlic in one oven tray.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes and onion into thick slices and spread them in the tray.
Mix the oil with the lemon juice, crushed garlic, paprika, cumin and salt, and brush it over the chicken and potatoes.
Lay the thighs on the potatoes, add half a cup of water and cover the tray with foil for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for another 20 minutes until golden on top.

k5.name: Eggplant Musaqqa'a with Minced Meat
k5.summary: Oven-roasted eggplant with minced meat and tomato sauce, with white rice.
steps: Slice the eggplant into rounds, brush with a little oil and roast at 220°C for 20 minutes until soft.
Brown the minced meat with the onion and garlic, then add the pepper, chopped tomatoes, spices and half a cup of water, and cook for 10 minutes.
Arrange the eggplant in a tray, spread the meat sauce over it and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve hot with white rice.

k6.name: Fish Sayadiyah
k6.summary: Fish fillet with rice cooked with browned onions and cumin.
steps: Season the fish with salt, cumin and lemon juice and leave for 15 minutes.
Fry the sliced onion in the oil until dark brown, and set half aside for the top.
Add 4 cups of hot water, salt and turmeric to the remaining onion and boil for 5 minutes, then add the washed rice and cook on low heat for 20 minutes.
Fry the fish, or bake it at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Serve the rice with the fish on top and the browned onion.

k7.name: Chicken Mandi
k7.summary: Spiced chicken cooked over basmati rice with cardamom and cumin.
steps: Season the halved chicken with the spices, garlic, lemon, salt and oil, and leave for an hour if you can.
Soften the onion in a pot, then add the washed rice, cardamom, 5 cups of boiling water and salt.
Set the chicken on a rack over the rice inside the pot, cover tightly and cook on very low heat for 60 minutes.
Brown the chicken skin in the oven for 10 minutes, then serve on the rice.
k7.tip: Marinating time is not included in the cooking time.

k8.name: Chicken and Vegetable Saloona
k8.summary: Chicken stew with potatoes, vegetables and tomato, served with white rice.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside. Soften the onion and garlic in the same pot.
Add the tomato paste, spices and dried lime, then return the chicken with 4 cups of hot water.
After 20 minutes add the diced potatoes, after 10 more the frozen vegetables, and cook for another 10 minutes.
Boil the rice separately and serve it with the saloona.

s1.name: Chicken and Eggplant Maqluba
s1.summary: Chicken, eggplant and rice, turned upside down onto one platter.
steps: Boil the cut chicken with the onion, salt and half the spices for 35 minutes, and keep the stock.
Slice the eggplant lengthways and fry it, or roast it in the oven, until golden.
In an oiled pot, layer the chicken, then the eggplant, then the washed rice seasoned with the rest of the spices and the turmeric.
Pour in stock to one centimetre above the rice and cook on low heat for 35 minutes.
Rest for 10 minutes, then turn it out onto the serving platter.

s2.name: Molokhia with Chicken
s2.summary: Molokhia with fried garlic and coriander, with chicken and white rice.
steps: Boil the chicken in 5 cups of water with salt for 25 minutes, then shred it and keep the stock.
Add the frozen molokhia to 4 cups of the boiling stock and stir until it melts, then boil for only 5 minutes.
Fry the crushed garlic with the coriander in the ghee until golden, and pour it over the molokhia.
Add the shredded chicken, and serve with white rice and lemon juice.

s3.name: Kofta and Potato Tray
s3.summary: Kofta fingers over potatoes in tomato sauce, baked in the oven.
steps: Knead the meat with half the finely chopped onion, the parsley, spices and salt, and shape it into fingers.
Slice the potatoes thinly and spread them in an oiled tray with the rest of the onion and the pepper.
Lay the kofta on top. Dissolve the tomato paste in one and a half cups of hot water with salt and pour it into the tray.
Cover and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes, then uncover for 15 minutes to brown.

s4.name: Oven Shish Tawook
s4.summary: Chicken cubes marinated in yoghurt and lemon, with roast potatoes.
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes and marinate it with the yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic, tomato paste, paprika and salt, for an hour if you can.
Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and salt and bake at 220°C for 15 minutes.
Spread the chicken on a second tray and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, turning once.
Serve the chicken with the potatoes.
s4.tip: Marinating time is not included in the cooking time.

s5.name: Mujaddara
s5.summary: Lentils and rice with crispy onions, served with yoghurt.
steps: Boil the lentils in 5 cups of water for 20 minutes until half cooked.
Fry the onion, cut in slivers, in the oil until brown and crisp, and set half aside for the top.
Add the washed rice, cumin, salt and the rest of the onion with its oil to the lentils, and adjust the water to one centimetre above.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes, and serve with the crispy onion and yoghurt.

s6.name: Pasta Béchamel
s6.summary: Layers of pasta, minced meat and béchamel under a mozzarella top.
steps: Boil and drain the pasta. Brown the meat with the onion and add the tomato paste, salt and pepper.
For the béchamel: melt the butter and stir the flour into it for a minute, then add the milk gradually, stirring until thick, and season.
In a tray: half the pasta mixed with a little béchamel, then the meat, then the rest of the pasta, then the béchamel and cheese.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden on top.

s7.name: Peas and Rice with Minced Meat
s7.summary: A pea, tomato and minced meat stew with white rice.
steps: Brown the minced meat with the onion until its liquid has gone, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomato paste and two cups of hot water, then the frozen peas, and cook for 20 minutes.
Cook the rice separately and serve it with the stew.

s8.name: Chicken Fatteh
s8.summary: Toasted bread, rice and chicken under a garlic yoghurt sauce.
steps: Boil the chicken with salt for 25 minutes, then shred it and keep the stock.
Cook the rice with a cup of the chicken stock and water.
Cut the bread into cubes and toast it in the oven until crisp.
Mix the yoghurt with the crushed garlic, tahini, lemon juice and salt.
In a deep dish: the bread, a little stock, the rice, then the chicken, with the yoghurt poured over.

q1.name: Creamy Chicken Fettuccine
q1.summary: Fettuccine in a cream sauce with chicken and mushrooms.
steps: Boil and drain the pasta, keeping half a cup of the cooking water.
Slice the chicken and brown it in the oil with salt and pepper for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and sliced mushrooms for 3 minutes, then the cream and cooking water, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the pasta and toss until the sauce coats it.

q2.name: Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
q2.summary: Rice tossed with chicken, mixed vegetables and egg in one pan.
steps: Boil the rice and let it cool; day-old rice is best.
Brown the chicken, in small cubes, in a wide pan and set aside.
Beat the eggs and stir them in the pan until set, then add the frozen vegetables and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the rice, chicken and soy sauce and toss everything on high heat for 3 minutes.

q3.name: Chicken Fajitas with Peppers
q3.summary: Strips of chicken and colourful peppers in tortilla wraps.
steps: Cut the chicken into thin strips and season with paprika, cumin, salt and lemon juice.
Brown the chicken in a hot pan for 6 minutes and set aside.
Toss the sliced onion and peppers in the same pan for 5 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Return the chicken for a minute and fill the warm tortillas.

q4.name: Shakshuka
q4.summary: Eggs cooked in a tomato and pepper sauce, with toasted bread.
steps: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes, cumin, paprika and salt, and cook for 8 minutes until thick.
Make small wells in the sauce, crack the eggs into them and cover the pan for 4 to 5 minutes.
Serve straight away with the toasted bread.

q5.name: Tuna and Sweetcorn Pasta Salad
q5.summary: A quick cold meal of pasta, tuna and sweetcorn.
steps: Boil the pasta, drain it and rinse it in cold water.
Drain the tuna and sweetcorn and dice the pepper small.
Mix everything with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Serve cold.

q6.name: Lentil Soup
q6.summary: Lentil soup with potato and lemon, with cheese toast.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the washed lentils, chopped potatoes and cumin.
Cover with 6 cups of hot water and cook for 25 minutes until the lentils break down.
Blend the soup with a hand blender, adjust the salt and add the lemon juice.
Toast the bread slices with the cheese in a pan and serve with the soup.

q7.name: Minced Meat Tortillas
q7.summary: Minced meat with peppers and spices, rolled in tortilla wraps.
steps: Brown the minced meat with the onion until its liquid has gone.
Add the sliced peppers, spices and salt, and stir for 5 minutes.
Spread the mixture with a cheese slice on each wrap, roll up and toast in a pan for a minute on each side.

q8.name: Tuna and Tomato Pasta
q8.summary: Pasta in a quick tomato sauce with tuna.
steps: Boil and drain the pasta.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the tomatoes, oregano and salt and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the drained tuna, then the pasta, and toss over the heat for two minutes.

h1.name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Sautéed Vegetables
h1.summary: Chicken in lemon and garlic, grilled in the pan with colourful vegetables.
steps: Season the chicken with lemon juice, crushed garlic, paprika, salt and a spoon of oil, and leave for 15 minutes.
Grill the chicken in a hot cast-iron pan for 5 to 6 minutes a side, then rest it for 5 minutes before slicing.
In the same pan, toss the frozen vegetables and sliced pepper with a spoon of oil and salt for 6 minutes.
Serve the chicken sliced over the vegetables.

h2.name: Tuna and Vegetable Salad
h2.summary: A filling salad of tuna, sweetcorn and cucumber with a lemon dressing.
steps: Drain the tuna and sweetcorn.
Dice the cucumber and pepper small.
Mix the lemon juice with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss everything together and serve cold.

h3.name: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
h3.summary: Red lentils with mixed vegetables and lemon, light and filling.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in a spoon of oil, then add the washed lentils and cumin.
Cover with 6 cups of hot water and cook for 20 minutes until soft.
Add the frozen vegetables for 8 minutes, then adjust the salt.
Serve with lemon juice.

h4.name: Vegetable Omelette with Labneh
h4.summary: Eggs with bell pepper, served with labneh and cucumber.
steps: Dice the pepper small and toss it in a spoon of oil for two minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt, pour over the pepper and cook covered on low heat for 5 minutes.
Serve with the labneh topped with zaatar, and sliced cucumber.

h5.name: Oven-Baked Yoghurt Chicken Thighs
h5.summary: Chicken marinated in yoghurt, lemon and garlic, roasted, with a cucumber salad.
steps: Marinate the chicken with half the yoghurt, the lemon juice, garlic, thyme and salt, for an hour if you can.
Roast at 210°C for 35 minutes until browned.
Mix the rest of the yoghurt with grated cucumber and salt, and serve with the chicken.
h5.tip: Marinating time is not included in the cooking time.

h6.name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
h6.summary: A clear chicken broth with vegetables and potato, warm and light.
steps: Boil the chicken in 7 cups of water with the garlic, bay leaves and salt for 20 minutes, then lift it out and shred it.
Add the diced potatoes to the broth for 10 minutes, then the frozen vegetables for 8 minutes.
Return the chicken to the soup, and serve with lemon juice and pepper.

h7.name: Grilled Kofta with Yoghurt Salad
h7.summary: Parsley kofta fingers grilled in the oven, with cucumber yoghurt.
steps: Knead the meat with the grated onion, chopped parsley, spices and salt, and shape it into fingers.
Grill the kofta in the oven at 220°C for 15 minutes, turning once.
Mix the yoghurt with grated cucumber, garlic and salt, and serve with the kofta.

h8.name: Baked Fish with Lemon and Vegetables
h8.summary: White fish fillet on vegetables, with lemon and cumin.
steps: Spread the vegetables in a tray with a spoon of oil and salt.
Season the fish with lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt, and lay it on the vegetables.
Bake at 200°C for 18 to 20 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
